materials_exhausted.note: Bounded best-effort source recovery checked XML/NXML, PDF text, OA package members/figures, DOCX supplement tables, packet database rows, and targeted merged corpus rows relevant to worker-2/4/6 gate failures.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed re-review recovered NP213 clinical efficacy/safety rows from primary XML/PDF and DOCX supplement tables, reconciled the single DRAMP literature-link row against primary article metadata and peptide identity text, replaced generic mechanism notes with source-located ontology claims, and closes rwk-complete-test-0001 with cautions.
summary: Worker-2/4/6 rework is source-reviewed and gate-clean; acceptance remains cautious because the current paper provides clinical/TEM endpoints rather than a conventional MIC activity table and the local DRAMP linkage is literature-only.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: The only packet-linked database row is a DRAMP literature link for PMID 32232410/DOI 10.1093/mmy/myaa015. Article metadata and the NP213 preparation section verify DOI/PMID and peptide identity; absent linked assay/sequence rows are recorded as a caution, not fabricated into conflicts.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Six source-supported NP213 activity/efficacy rows were recovered: four clinical culture-negative/improvement endpoints, one TEM exposure endpoint, and one MIC context derived directly from the Figure 4 2 x MIC caption. DOCX supplement AE tables plus XML safety sections support toxicity/safety records; no hemolysis/cytotoxicity table is locally present.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: TEM and discussion support a direct fungal cell-damage/membrane-active phenotype for T. rubrum without molecular target mapping. Clinical efficacy remains phenotype-level and is not overpromoted to direct mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_adjudication: The prior full_source_review_not_completed, database_conflicts_require_adjudication, and no_supported_activity_rows_extracted blockers were checked against source paths and resolved with explicit cautions.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary source supports clinical culture-negative endpoints and a TEM 2 x MIC exposure condition; no standalone local MIC activity table is present in this 2020 paper.

Packet-local DRAMP linkage contains one literature row and no linked assay/sequence/activity rows. The primary article supports NP213 identity; APD6 AP05243 is retained only as cross-paper context for the earlier 2019 AAC article.
OOXML parsing recovered supplementary adverse-event tables and species-identification Table S3; no spreadsheet/PDF supplement with additional quantitative activity rows is locally present.
The paper reports clinical AEs and plasma non-detection/below-LLOQ findings, but no hemolysis, HC50, CC50, or cell-viability assay was recoverable locally.
